Угоди з $NVDA, $TSLA, $AAPL і $ANT рахуються в обсяг для рейтингу (leaderboard) утричі (3X).

watch: У пості немає дат, порогів, таблиці рівнів і умов участі. Не торгуйте заради нагороди, доки не прочитаєте повні правила на сторінці кампанії.

Вартість $XAU змінюється разом із ціною золота.

en.summary: Bitrue RWA × TradFi Trading Campaign: trade tokenized stocks, gold and similar assets on Bitrue to share 80,000 USDT in rewards. One person can unlock up to 200 USDT in trading rewards, and the top 10 traders win $XAU rewards. The post gives no dates or eligibility rules.

Trades on $NVDA, $TSLA, $AAPL and $ANT count 3X toward leaderboard volume.
To compete for $XAU, you need to finish in the top 10 traders on the leaderboard.

payout.how: Not stated. Check the campaign page for where rewards appear and whether you must claim them.

watch: The post has no dates, thresholds, tier table or eligibility rules. Don't trade for the reward before reading the full rules on the campaign page.
The 3X boost counts only toward the leaderboard, and only for $NVDA, $TSLA, $AAPL and $ANT.
Only the top 10 traders get $XAU. A leaderboard is a competition — heavy trading doesn't guarantee a place.
Trading costs fees, and stock and gold token prices can fall; the reward may not cover losses.
The value of $XAU moves with the gold price.

faq.a: RWA (real-world assets) are tokens linked to real things like stocks or gold. TradFi is traditional finance — stocks, commodities and similar markets.
Every 1 USDT you trade on $NVDA, $TSLA, $AAPL or $ANT counts as 3 USDT for your leaderboard ranking.
